description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four different model configurations—T5 + LoRA, MBart + LoRA, T5 + AdaLoRA, and MBart + AdaLoRA—on the ROUGE-1 metric during fine-tuning across varying values of the rank parameter $ r $, represented on the x-axis as $ \log r $, which spans from approximately 1 to 8 on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “ROUGE-1,” ranges from 5 to 35, also on a linear scale, with major gridlines every 5 units. The red line with circular markers (T5 + LoRA) starts at ~24.5 when $ \log r = 1 $, rises steadily to ~37 at $ \log r = 8 $. The purple line with circular markers (MBart + LoRA) begins at ~6, dips slightly to ~6.5 at $ \log r = 2 $, then climbs sharply to ~37 at $ \log r = 8 $. The green line with circular markers (T5 + AdaLoRA) starts at ~24.5, increases gradually to ~38 at $ \log r = 8 $. The orange line with circular markers (MBart + AdaLoRA) begins at ~6, rises steeply to ~38 at $ \log r = 8 $, showing the most rapid initial growth among all lines. All lines exhibit a generally increasing trend with respect to $ \log r $, with MBart + AdaLoRA and T5 + AdaLoRA achieving the highest final ROUGE-1 scores.
